execution.owner_trace: At most one live private serving owner. Each context has five separately constructed and closed owners, each with one cold prime followed by32 warm requests; disclose finite trace, not fully prewarmed production speed

completion.goal: Must beat ALL four frozen challengers at BOTH contexts with the simultaneous one-sided95 lower bounds >0, all canonical/strict quality gates, genuine nonzero Mapper, complete raw matrices, written report and inspected separate acceptance/TPS/diagnostic figures
completion.failures: Preserve partial evidence and label PARTIAL. Never discard a slow/EOS/zero-injection document, change comparator or resume a partial root.
completion.disclosure: One frozen model pair/Mapper/strategy and H100, deterministic unused validation cohort; not global best over all SpecExtend settings or original Vicuna benchmark
